subject: English
question_text: Put the following parts of the story in correct order to
stimulus: make the whole story. Only the corresponding numbers of the sentences need to be written. 18 = 8 (a) In 1271 he set out from Venice to China when he was only 15. (b) They had travelled by land and sea, over mountains and across deserts. (c) For transport they had used ships, camels, horses and donkeys. (d) He was accompanied by his father and uncle. (e) He was one of the greatest adventurous men. (f) It took the Polos over three years to reach China (g) Actually at that time journey was very difficult because of no speedy vehicles.
